meta.name: invoice-organizer
meta.description: Automatically organizes invoices and receipts for tax preparation by reading messy files, extracting key information, renaming them consistently, and sorting them into logical folders. Turns hours of manual bookkeeping into minutes of automated organization.

copy.tagline: 自动整理发票和收据，为报税做好准备
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每月要花数小时手动整理发票和收据
copy.tagline_en: Automatically organize invoices and receipts for tax preparation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spend hours manually organizing invoices and receipts each month

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会读取发票和收据文件，提取日期、商家、金额等信息，然后按统一格式重命名文件，并按商家、类别或年份等整理到文件夹中，最后生成一份 CSV 汇总表。
howto.when: 当你有一个杂乱的发票文件夹，并告诉 Claude 需要整理这些发票时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这个文件夹里的发票，按商家分类。
say.note: Claude 会扫描文件并询问你具体的整理方式。

say.text: 把发票重命名为“日期-商家-发票-产品”格式，并按年份和类别归档。
say.note: Claude 会执行重命名和归档操作。

howto.what_en: Claude reads invoice and receipt files, extracts date, vendor, amount, etc., renames them consistently, and organizes them into folders by vendor, category, or year. It also creates a CSV summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a messy folder of invoices and ask Claude to organize them.

say_en.text: Organize the invoices in this folder by vendor.
say_en.note: Claude will scan and ask for your preferred organization.

say_en.text: Rename invoices to 'YYYY-MM-DD Vendor - Invoice - Product' and sort by year and category.
say_en.note: Claude will rename and archive the files.
